addcmd.help:
Adds a custom command to the bot that will output whatever is in the <output> field

Attributes
-----------
cmd: str
    The command to add. such as `lol` - No need to add the ! 
output: str
    The output of the command. Can be a URL if you want it to show an image/link/etc

age.help: Show your age if stored, or optionally return the time from [day] to now

aiconfig.help:
Enable or disable !ai and !sai per-channel (Bot Admin only).

!aiconfig              — show current setting for this channel
!aiconfig enabled on   — enable !ai and !sai in this channel
!aiconfig enabled off  — disable !ai and !sai in this channel

aqi.help:
Show the air quality index of <location>
Can be invoked without location if you have a set location

beer.help: Search Untappd for a beer to return ratings, alcohol, etc

bimage.help: Google Image Search and return the results in a switchable embed

bnews.help: Search bing news for a specific topic

book.help: Find a <book> on openlibrary.org and return some rating info and a link

bsky.help: Testing bluesky API. Can show the latest bluesky of a user

checkwotd.help: Debug function shows you the current wotd, who set it, and when

clai.help: Ask Claude Opus 4.5 via GitHub Copilot API (with compacted channel + user context)

clai-acl.help: Manage AI command access list. !clai-acl on/off/add/remove/list

claiconfig.help: Show or change AI compaction settings (Bot Admin only)

claihelp.help: Show all AI commands and what they do.

claipersona.help:
Manage persona commands (Bot Admin only).

!claipersona create <name> @user [--tokens N] [--provider copilot|glm]
!claipersona delete <name>
!claipersona list
!claipersona info <name>

claireset.help:
Nuke compaction cache and immediately rebuild (owner only)

!claireset       — rebuild this channel
!claireset all    — rebuild all cached channels

claistatus.help: Show AI usage stats. !claistatus for server-wide, !claistatus #channel for detail.

claisummary.help:
Show the current compaction summary for a channel.

!claisummary          — this channel
!claisummary #channel — specific channel

claiuserprompt.help:
Set per-user system prompt (Bot Admin only).
!claiuserprompt @user <prompt> — set for this channel
!claiuserprompt @user #channel <prompt> — set for a specific channel
!claiuserprompt @user global <prompt> — set server-wide
!claiuserprompt @user clear — remove prompt
!claiuserprompt @user — view prompt
!claiuserprompt list — show all

coin.help: Try to lookup a cryptocoin with yahoo finance

coliru.help:
Compiles code via Coliru.

You have to pass in a code block with the language syntax
either set to one of these:

- cpp
- c
- python
- py
- haskell

Anything else isn't supported. The C++ compiler uses g++ -std=c++14.

The python support is now 3.5.2.

Please don't spam this for Stacked's sake.

copilot-auth.help:
Start GitHub device code flow to authenticate Copilot (Bot Admin only).

Displays a code and URL. Open the URL in a browser, enter the code,
and authorize the app. The bot will detect authorization automatically.

copilot-auth-status.help: Check current Copilot authentication status (Bot Admin only).

copilot-deauth.help: Remove stored Copilot credentials (Bot Admin only).

describecommand.help:
Describes the custom command

Attributes
-----------
cmd: str
    The command to add. such as `lol` - No need to add the ! 
description: str
    The general description of what is in the command

find.help:
Find a custom command

Attributes
-----------
find: str
    What to search for in the cmmand name or description

glm.help: Ask using GLM via OpenAI-compatible API with context

glmconfig.help: Show or change GLM settings (Bot Admin only)

google.help: Attempts to use the google search snippet to find specific sections on wikipedia (it's not very good at it)

Create a poll using reactions.

!poll what's for lunch?
1) pizza

reload.help:
Command which Reloads a Module.

reload all.help: reload all modules in the module folder

rpics.help: Search a subreddit for any image files and return 2 random ones

sai.help: Ask "smart" gemini a question. It uses google and is better for current event questions.

sclai.help: Ask Claude Opus 4.5 with web search + compacted channel context for current events

set.help: Use '!help set' for more info. Lets you set user related information for convenience

set birthday.help: Set your birthday for things like age

set last.fm.help: Set your last.fm user name for !np

set location.help: Set your approximate location for things like weather and localized results. Also sets timezone automatically

set strava.help: Set your strava athlete ID such as https://www.strava.com/athletes/<######>

sglm.help: Ask GLM with web search + channel context

spirits.help: Search Distiller.com for a <spirit> and return some information about it

stock.help: Look up a stock and show its current price, change, etc

strava.help:

Show sunrise/sunset for a <location>

trivia time.help: Set the time in seconds you get to answer the question

trump.help: Show trump's most recent words of wisdom

tts.help: Voice TTS commands. Use !tts join to start.

tts join.help:
Join a voice channel and monitor a text channel for TTS.

Usage:
    !tts join                          — Monitor current channel, join your VC
    !tts join #palship                 — Monitor #palship, join your VC
    !tts join #palship General Voice   — Monitor #palship, join "General Voice"

tts leave.help: Disconnect from voice and stop TTS.

tts set.help:
Adjust TTS settings.

Usage:
    !tts set                    — Show current settings
    !tts set queue_size 10      — Max queued messages (1-50)
    !tts set max_length 2000    — Max message length in chars (100-4000)

tts skip.help: Skip the currently playing TTS message.

tts voice.help: Set a global voice override (all users same voice), or 'auto' for per-user voices.

tts voices.help: List available TTS voices. Optionally filter by locale (default: en).

ud.help: Searches for a term on urbandictionary.com

wfl.help: What's for lunch? You probably don't want it

wolfram.help: Query wolfram alpha and return the output

worldcup.help: Show World Cup 2026 matches for today (or a given date).

worldcupgroup.help: Show one World Cup group's standings (A–L).

worldcupschedule.help: Show upcoming World Cup matches for the next N days (1–30).

worldcupstandings.help: Show World Cup group standings — one embed per group.

yr.help:

yt.help: Search for a youtube video and return some info along with an embedded link

data/customcommands.sqlite.name: cfind
data/customcommands.sqlite.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE cfind USING FTS5(cmd, description)

data/customcommands.sqlite.name: cfind_config
data/customcommands.sqlite.sql: CREATE TABLE 'cfind_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID

data/customcommands.sqlite.name: cfind_content
data/customcommands.sqlite.sql: CREATE TABLE 'cfind_content'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c0, c1)

data/customcommands.sqlite.name: cfind_data
data/customcommands.sqlite.sql: CREATE TABLE 'cfind_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)

data/customcommands.sqlite.name: cfind_docsize
data/customcommands.sqlite.sql: CREATE TABLE 'cfind_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)

data/customcommands.sqlite.name: cfind_idx
data/customcommands.sqlite.sql: CREATE TABLE 'cfind_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

data/customcommands.sqlite.name: commands
data/customcommands.sqlite.sql: CREATE TABLE 'commands' ('cmd' TEXT UNIQUE ON CONFLICT REPLACE, 'output' TEXT, 'owner' TEXT, 'description' TEXT)

data/customcommands.sqlite.name: cfindd
data/customcommands.sqlite.sql: CREATE TRIGGER cfindd AFTER DELETE ON commands BEGIN DELETE FROM cfind WHERE cmd = old.cmd; END

data/customcommands.sqlite.name: cfindi
data/customcommands.sqlite.sql: CREATE TRIGGER cfindi AFTER INSERT ON commands BEGIN INSERT INTO cfind(cmd, description) VALUES (new.cmd, new.description); END

data/customcommands.sqlite.name: cfindu
data/customcommands.sqlite.sql: CREATE TRIGGER cfindu AFTER UPDATE ON commands BEGIN DELETE FROM cfind WHERE cmd = old.cmd; INSERT INTO cfind(cmd, description) VALUES (new.cmd, new.description); END
